$comment: V2 - reference-derived typography (reference/analysis/findings-typography.json, confidence 0.65 on letterforms, 0.75 on behavior). Fonts bundled in public/fonts - deterministic rendering.

provenance.source: reference = bold grotesque (vision conf 0.65); Archivo adopted as closest bundled grotesque
neutral companion for sublines/labels (reference letterforms unreadable at sample res)

scale.$comment: Sizes in px @1080x1920. Reference tiers (landscape 576p): headline ~8% frame height, subline ~3%, micro-label ~1.5%. Portrait short-side mapping: headline 8-9% of 1080 = 86-97px (adopted 96), subline ref 3% = 32px but raised to 52 for phone readability (documented deviation), label ref 1.5% = 16px raised to 34 for legibility (documented deviation).

provenance.source: ref tier1 8% frame height mapped to portrait short side; lineHeight ref ~1.1 tight leading (adopted 1.08)
ref tier2 subline regular-weight under headline; size raised vs ref for readability
ref micro-labels under objects, center-aligned, slightly wide tracking (conf 0.75); size raised vs ref
ref lighter subtitle tier below subline
derived: between headline and subline tiers for quotation use
derived: number-led variant of headline tier

rules.alignmentNote: Reference blocks are predominantly left-aligned (vision conf 0.75); labels under objects stay centered
rules.accentEmphasis: color shift plus weight on key words (reference behavior, conf 0.75)
rules.textAnimation: sequential word-by-word reveal, quick fade, left-to-right (reference behavior, conf 0.65) - map to WordReveal
